headline: Frontline Bases Flip as Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: On day 251 the conflict remains undecided, but the last three hours have sharpened the picture of the most volatile sectors. Godcrofts continues its relentless churn with 56 ownership changes in the past 24 hours, while Fishermans Row and Weathered Expanse each recorded 30 flips, the newest events logged within the last hour. Stlican Shelf added 26 transitions, Stonecradle 14, and Linn Mercy nine, all showing a mix of captures and neutralisations for both factions. Casualties on these fronts remain high: Weathered Expanse alone added roughly 9,600 Colonial and 13,100 Warden losses in the last day, and Godcrofts saw comparable but lower totals. Enlistments are climbing sharply on the active fronts — Weathered Expanse (+52 per hour), Linn Mercy (+21), and Stlican Shelf (+37) — while the majority of regions report no base movement and only modest casualty increments. DeadLands, Farranac Coast, and Callahans Passage have gone quiet after earlier bursts. The strategic map therefore hinges on the six sectors above for any near‑term ownership swings.
